address: 88 rue de Metz, Le Touquet-Paris-Plage, 62520, France
bio: A few streets away from the seafront, this restaurant is in sync with the markets and seasons and very much appreciated by local gourmets! They know how to pull off happy marriages of flavours, as in the asparagus, egg, morels and pancetta, or the meagre with capers and spinach. Friendly welcome....
